The duplicate-range correction itself happens on the device before sync — not automatable via XML — so the envelope carries only the two records the office ever receives: the corrected 10:37 punch and the new 10:40 punch, both BarcodeBadge Time In records for one employee.
dayOffset -2: B1/B2/B3 must never share an employee-day under workers=2.

expected.cards[].record is the 0-based index into records; the flow mints references in record order and copies the record's gps onto the expectation. panel: true marks the card whose Time In side panel is opened; its display names come from fixture.json.

expected.envelope: sections replaces the old '<TimeCard_Records' grep (exactly one section); employeeSources {BarcodeBadge: 2} is the old split-count; absentTags ['CardType'] is sample fidelity — TimeIn derives from DateIn+TimeIn, no CardType tag; gpsFixes 1 — exactly one record carries a fix.

cleanup: the timeCards step sweeps employee 6001's fixture day (all card types) before the import and deletes the imported cards after the test; the flow passes sweep:false to deliverAndVerifyCards so exactly one cleanup path is live.
